name: KSM Metal Fabrication
old_description: If you need short-run metal fabrication services, help improving the manufacturability of a part to reduce cost, and/or custom metal fabrication services from a company that really knows its stuff, KSM Metal Fabrication is the place for you!
about:
KSM Metal Fabrication was founded in 1986 in Troy, Ohio, just north of Dayton. The company operates as a woman-owned business from a 27,000-square-foot facility in Miami County.

The shop specializes in low-volume, short-run, and prototype metal fabrication, offering services such as laser cutting, shearing, forming, welding (TIG, MIG, seam, spot, and sanitary), and assembly. It also coordinates partner services for heat treating, CNC machining (milling, turning, EDM), metal spinning, plating, anodizing, and powder coating. Typical production runs range from 25 to 1,000 pieces, with prototypes delivered in days.

KSM serves the aerospace, food equipment, and automotive industries. In aerospace, it has over 40 years of experience fabricating heat shields for aircraft wheels and brakes. For food equipment manufacturers, it produces custom stainless-steel fabrications meeting cGMP requirements, including carts, guards, tables, and conveying systems. Automotive customers rely on KSM for low-volume production parts, fixtures, and prototypes.

The company emphasizes quick turnaround—citing over 99% on-time delivery—and design-for-manufacturability consultation to reduce costs. Its certifications include ITAR, AS9100:2016 Rev D, and ISO 9001:2015.
